caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded ceramic jug with a short, narrow neck and a small lip. The jug is light beige or grey in color with smooth, even shading that suggests a matte surface. Two distinct areas of damage are illustrated: one is located on the shoulder near the rim, and another lower on the side; both are outlined and shaded in brownish-grey tones. Blue glaze or liquid appears to be seeping from each damaged area and running down the jug's surface. The upper damaged area is connected to the lower one by a dashed line indicating a relationship between these points. In the top right corner, there is a rectangular stamp with the text "S.T. BREWER. NEW LONDON 1," and in the bottom right corner, outside the rectangle framing the jug, the name "Annie B. Johnston" is handwritten.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
